title: Async Collaboration Capsules
outcome: Package context, media, decisions, and executable actions into compact asynchronous handoffs
breakthrough: Teams collaborate across time zones without endless threads
lane: Human communication, presence, and relationship intelligence

phases.name: Phase 1 - Build the Async Collaboration Capsules Core

subphases.name: 1.1 Async Collaboration Capsules Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed experiments, hypotheses, datasets, runs, and results required to package context, media, decisions, and executable actions into compact asynchronous handoffs, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for voice, messaging, meetings, multilingual communication, team presence, and relationship context; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 Async Collaboration Capsules Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: package context, media, decisions, and executable actions into compact asynchronous handoffs.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make Async Collaboration Capsules Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 Async Collaboration Capsules Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using speech understanding, sentiment signals, conversation state, translation, and social graph inference.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 Async Collaboration Capsules Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the live conversation room, relationship map, meeting console, and ambient communication panel, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale Async Collaboration Capsules into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 Async Collaboration Capsules Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 Async Collaboration Capsules Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: Teams collaborate across time zones without endless threads. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.
